name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 84 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 84 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Sanctions have been imposed on eight Israeli construction firms for building West Bank settlements, aiming to support a two-state solution. Israeli airstrikes hit Gaza’s Nasser Hospital, killing a doctor and a child, and later killed three Hamas militants, including an attacker from the Oct. 7 assault. In the West Bank, Israeli settlers entered a Palestinian village near Jericho, clashing with residents, seizing homes, and a car-ramming incident was judged not a terror attack. Winter rains have deepened the humanitarian crisis in Gaza, while the conflict has caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sanksjoner er blitt innført mot åtte israelske byggefirmaer for å bygge bosetninger på Vestbredden, med mål om å støtte en to-statsløsning. Israelske luftangrep rammet Nasser-sykehuset i Gaza, og drepte en lege og et barn, og senere drepte de tre Hamas-militante, inkludert en angriper fra angrepet 7. oktober. På Vestbredden gikk israelske bosettere inn i en palestinsk landsby nær Jeriko, kom i konflikt med innbyggerne, tok over hus, og en bilkollisjon ble vurdert som ikke et terrorangrep. Vinterregnet har forverret den humanitære krisen i Gaza, mens konflikten har forårsaket 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
